title: Is your brain the key to better AI robots?
script: Forget watching YouTube videos—physical AI is leveling up. To train robots that actually work in the real world, researchers are moving past simple camera footage. They’re now using dense annotation, which is basically tagging every tiny detail in a video, and multiple camera angles. But here is the wild part: they want to use your brain waves to teach AI next. Could your own neural patterns be the final piece of the puzzle? The future of physical AI is officially getting mental.
description: Researchers are moving beyond video data to train physical AI. They are now exploring brain wave integration to teach robots how to interact with the world. #AI
source_title: Are brain waves the next unlock for physical AI?
